newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's President Leghari to visit China.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's President Leghari to visit China.

text.p: Pakistani President Farooq Leghari will hold talks with his Chinese counterpart Jiang Zemin and Prime Minister Li Peng during a state visit to China on April 29 and 30, an official announcement said on Tuesday.
Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's information adviser Mushahid Hussain said Pakistan's ties with China were the cornerstone of its foreign policy, the official news agency APP reported.
"China has never interfered in the internal affairs of Pakistan and has always assisted it in its hour of need," APP quoted him as telling a four-man Chinese delegation.
Pakistan and China have traditionally enjoyed close ties, though diplomats say Beijing's moves to improve relations with India in recent months have created some unease in Islamabad.
